label: Key indicators for sector accounts - annual data

label.B2G_B3G_RAT_S11: Gross profit share of non-financial corporations (B2G_B3G/B1G*100)
label.B7G_R_HAB_2010: Adjusted gross disposable income of households in real terms per capita (2010=100)
label.B7G_R_HAB_GR: Adjusted gross disposable income of households in real terms per capita (percentage change on previous period)
label.B7G_N_HAB_GR: Adjusted gross disposable income of households in nominal terms per capita (percentage change on previous period)
label.P4_R_HAB_2010: Actual final consumption in real terms per capita (2010=100)
label.P4_R_HAB_GR: Actual final consumption in real terms per capita (percentage change on previous period)
label.IRG_S11: Gross investment rate of non-financial corporations (P51G/B1G*100)
label.ROCE_S11: Gross return on capital employed, before taxes, of non-financial corporations: (B2G_B3G/(AF2+AF3+AF4+AF5, liab - assets)*100)
label.ROE_S11: Net return on equity, after taxes, of non-financial corporations: ((B4N-D5PAY)/(AF5, liab - assets)*100)
label.DIR_S11: Net debt-to-income ratio, after taxes, of non-financial corporations: ((AF2+AF3+AF4, liab - assets)/(B4N-D5PAY)*100)
label.DIR_S14: Gross debt-to-income ratio of households: ((AF4, liab)/(B6G+D8net)*100)
label.DIR_S14_S15: Gross debt-to-income ratio of households: ((AF4, liab)/(B6G+D8net)*100)

extension.description:
The set of key indicators for annual sector accounts are derived from non-financial transactions. They are broken down by institutional sectors (households, government and corporations). 

The annual key indicators are deemed meaningful for economic analysis and include investment rates, household saving rate, profit share, investment-to-GDP ratio, returns of non-financial corporations and debt-to-income ratios.

The series are calculated following the European System of Accounts (ESA 2010) methodology.
